description: Required output format for the radiotherapy clinical analytics engine. All fields are required unless noted.

n_patients.description: Total number of patient records in the dataset

bed_tumor_mean.description: Mean BED for tumor (alpha/beta=10 Gy) across patients with valid dose data, in Gy10

bed_tumor_std.description: Sample standard deviation of BED for tumor, in Gy10

eqd2_tumor_mean.description: Mean EQD2 for tumor (alpha/beta=10 Gy), in Gy

eqd2_late_mean.description: Mean EQD2 for late-responding tissue (alpha/beta=3 Gy), in Gy

n_inconsistent_dose.description: Count of patients where |total_dose - dose_per_fraction * n_fractions| > 1 Gy

n_extended_treatment.description: Count of patients with overall treatment time > 50 days

median_os_months.description: Median overall survival in months, or null if not reached

ci_95_lower_12m.description: Lower bound of 95% CI for S(12) using Greenwood formula

ci_95_upper_12m.description: Upper bound of 95% CI for S(12) using Greenwood formula

stage_stratified.description: KM analysis stratified by disease stage

chi_square.description: Log-rank chi-square statistic comparing Stage III vs Stage IV (IVA+IVB), 1 degree of freedom

p_value.description: p-value from chi-square distribution with 1 degree of freedom

pre_rt_depleted_count.description: Number of patients with pre-RT skeletal muscle status 'SM depleted'

post_rt_depleted_count.description: Number of patients with post-RT skeletal muscle status 'SM depleted'

pre_rt_prevalence.description: Fraction of patients with pre-RT depletion (count / patients with valid status)

post_rt_prevalence.description: Fraction of patients with post-RT depletion (count / patients with valid status)

mean_smi_pre_rt.description: Mean pre-RT L3 skeletal muscle index in cm2/m2

mean_smi_post_rt.description: Mean post-RT L3 skeletal muscle index in cm2/m2

mean_smi_change.description: Mean SMI change (post - pre) in cm2/m2

transition_dn.description: Count: depleted pre-RT -> not depleted post-RT

transition_nd.description: Count: not depleted pre-RT -> depleted post-RT

transition_nn.description: Count: not depleted pre-RT -> not depleted post-RT
